sources.title: Tianmen Mountain Guide: Tickets, Routes, and Travel Tips
sources.content:
Tianmen Mountain (Heaven's Door Mountain) stands at 1,519 meters in Zhangjiajie. It's renowned for the world's longest cable car and dramatic glass skywalk experiences.

Location: 20 minutes walking from Zhangjiajie Central Bus Station
Hours: 8:00 AM-7:00 PM (park entry closes at 4:00 PM)
Admission: 288 CNY (discounts for children under 18 and seniors over 60)

Route Options (Three Cable Car Lines):
Line A: Traditional route using the longest cable car, then coach up the famous 99-Bend Mountain Road, descending via express cable car
Line B (Recommended): Queue for going down is usually shorter, returns directly to downtown. Takes express cable car up, then 99-Bend descent by coach
Line C: Best for those prone to motion sickness, uses express cable car both ways

Summit Exploration Routes:
West Line (1.5 hours, 2.8 km): Mostly flat terrain with glass cliff paths, suspension bridge, ideal for families
East Line (2.5 hours, 3.7 km): Quieter with more stairs, for experienced hikers

Key Attractions: 999 Heavenly Stairs leading to Tianmen Cave, Glass Skywalk sections, Suspension Bridge, 99-Bend Mountain Road, Forest Observation Cable Car to highest viewpoint at 1,518m

Best seasons: Autumn (Sept-Oct) clearest visibility; summer provides bigger chance for sea of clouds

Crowd avoidance: Arrive by 7:30 AM to avoid 2+ hour queues. Avoid June (heavy rains), July-August (summer rush), and national holidays.

What to bring: Warm layers (5-10°C cooler at summit), comfortable shoes, sun protection, portable raincoat

Transportation: From airport/high-speed rail 10-15 min taxi (15 CNY). From Wulingyuan Town 1-1.5 hour coach (13 CNY).

sources.title: Tianmen Mountain Travel Guide & Tips, 2026 Updated
sources.content:
Tianmen Mountain is Zhangjiajie's must-see spot where visitors can experience the longest cable car on Earth, daring skywalks, and the miraculous Tianmen Cave.

The Cableway is the longest one-way recycling passenger cableway in the world with a total length of 7455 meters and height gap of 1279 meters.

Glass Skywalks consist of three sections requiring visitors to wear shoe covers, suspended on cliffs with transparent glass floors.

Tongtian Avenue (Heavenly Avenue) has 99 sharp turns of about 180° with a length of 10.77km and elevation rising from 200m to 1300m.

It is recommended to enter the park early between 7:30-8:30 to avoid tour groups. Tianmen Mountain implements a real-name time-slot reservation system; walk-in tickets are not available.

Excluding transfer and waiting times, it takes 4 to 5 hours to visit. Best seasons: April-May for spring flowers; September-November for clear crisp weather; June-August for cooler mountain escape but more rain.

sources.content: Tianmen Mountain comprehensive guide with itinerary tips. sources.content: Tianmen Mountain National Forest Park Travel Guide 2026. Highlights include the Glass Skywalk, Cableway, and Heaven's Gate. The park is located just 8km from Zhangjiajie city center, making it one of the most accessible major attractions. Tickets must be booked in advance with time-slot reservations.

sources.title: Tianmen Mountain National Forest Park (2026) - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Tianmen Mountain visitor reviews. Absolutely stunning views and thrilling experiences. The glass skywalk is not for the faint-hearted. The cable car ride is spectacular. Book tickets well in advance. Wear comfortable shoes and bring warm layers. The 99-Bend Road is incredible to experience by bus. Allow a full day for the visit.

sources.title: 天门山_百度百科
sources.content:
天门山位于湖南省张家界市永定区，古称嵩梁山，属武陵山脉向东进入洞庭湖平原的余脉，海拔1518.6米。位于大庸中路11号，属中亚热带山原型季风气候，温度常年较市区低6-8℃。

天门洞：山体中部的自然溶洞，高131.5米，宽57米，深60米，形成于三国时期，被称为世界罕见的高海拔天然穿山溶洞。

索道系统：世界上最长的高山客运索道，全长7455米，运行时间28分钟。

玻璃栈道：建设了多条悬空玻璃栈道，提供刺激的游览体验。

旅游区总面积96平方千米，山顶面积达2平方千米。开放时间07:00-16:00，门票价格258元（含大索道、环保车）。获得5A级景区认证。

sources.content: Detailed guide on how to visit Tianmen Mountain with route options A, B, and C explained. Each route offers different combinations of cable car and coach transportation.
